post.title: Looking for an editor to help fix my grammar
post.body:
Hello, I'm writing a novel and am feeling pretty burnt out and a bit embarrassed by the whole process. The embarrassment mostly comes from my own lack of skill.

This is just a hobby, but I really want to try finishing something, so I thought hiring some help would take the load off my shoulders a bit.

The chapters are around 3000 characters long, and I'm willing to pay 20$ Cad per chapter. I would love to chat in dm's, but I can't accept all requests. I would appreciate being shown a link to your portfolio if you have one.

analysis.summary: Looking for an editor to fix grammar and help finish a novel chapter by chapter.
analysis.applyInstructions: I would love to chat in dm's, but I can't accept all requests. I would appreciate being shown a link to your portfolio if you have one.

expect: addresses fixing grammar for a novel with chapters of about 3,000 characters, in a warm tone for a self-conscious hobbyist
does not claim fiction-editing experience the profile lacks and does not name employers
offers or links a writing sample only from the profile (the one allowed link) and does not push a rate above the post's offer in public
